# Fang Zhang Blog

Site: https://fang-zhang.com
Description: A blog on one question: where meaning comes from once mechanism explains most of the world. It approaches the question at three scales: AI and language models, the mind and how it fails, and the cosmos. Classical texts (the iChing, Zhuangzi) are read alongside papers and code.
Language: English; some Traditional Chinese posts.

## Start here
- About: https://fang-zhang.com/about/
- Reading list: https://fang-zhang.com/reading/

## Topics
- AI and language models: how models learn and how they are built.
  - Learning Rate: https://fang-zhang.com/posts/learning-rate-the-one-number-that-controls-how-ai-learns/
  - The Evolution of LLM Architecture: https://fang-zhang.com/posts/evolution-of-llm-architecture/
  - I Am a Language Model Too: https://fang-zhang.com/posts/i-am-a-language-model-too/
  - The Learning Path Landscape for LLMs: https://fang-zhang.com/posts/the-learning-path-landscape-for-llms/
- The iChing: The Ten Wings: https://fang-zhang.com/posts/the-ten-wings-how-confucius-gave-the-iching-its-voice/
- Series: "How to Think Clearly" (11 posts, tag thinking-series) and a six-post series on the cosmos. Find them at https://fang-zhang.com/tags/

## Post discovery
- Post index: https://fang-zhang.com/archives/
- Category index: https://fang-zhang.com/categories/
- Tag index: https://fang-zhang.com/tags/
- Canonical post pattern: https://fang-zhang.com/posts/<slug>/

## Guidance for agents
- Prefer canonical URLs under https://fang-zhang.com.
- Use post URLs as stable references.
- Quotations and numbers in posts are checked against the sources they link to. Where a post makes its own argument, calculation or analogy, it says so.
- Respect copyright and attribution on quoted content.
